rules.interpolation: single pass; inserted values are never interpreted as template syntax
rules.validation: Reject unknown or missing placeholders at startup, including overrides. Validate identity and numeric values before interpolation. Validate only the selected composition after selection or transformation.
rules.overrides: SQUAD_PROMPTS_DIR replaces existing template IDs only; omitted files retain embedded defaults. Overrides must preserve registered selections and the blind prefix transformation.
rules.assembly: Concatenate listed templates in order with a newline separator. Member persona is included in room.system, never in judge.system. Judge attempts contain exactly one system message and one user message; append repair_suffix inside that user message.
rules.sources: Source records enter authorized projections once. Round tasks do not repeat setup or barrier source material. No implicit history lookup or payload widening.
rules.mode_visibility: Reject material outside each authorized_input_projection. fanout inputs are actor-specific. A fresh audit receives no earlier conversational history. Schemas and repairs preserve the same restrictions.
rules.repairs: Only authorized attempt-scoped rejected output and validator data; repair shares the owning task attempt budget.
rules.schema_ownership: Consume canonical instantiated schemas from Contests and squad-protocol; no prompt-owned alternative output schemas.
rules.reports: Census and crosscheck assemble accepted artifacts without a model report call. Survey and probe use their registered report judge compositions.
rules.versioning: Increment version for prompt or composition changes. Freeze settings at contest creation and record rendered/override hashes, effective limits, schema and resolved model identities under canonical provenance.
